content.title: IHG boosts presence in Germany with third Vignette Collection
content.summary: The hotel is located in Eltville-Erbach and has 53 rooms and suites, as well as a range of dining venues.

content.title: IHG brings Ruby to US, targeting urban micro market
content.summary: The hotel company said the German brand — which it acquired in February for $116 million — presents an opportunity for owners “often challenged by significant barriers to entry” in urban settings.

thumbnail.caption: A rendering of a U.S. guest room at a Ruby hotel.

content.title: New Hotel Indigo in New Cairo to open in 2031
content.summary: The hotel expands IHG’s Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio in Northern Africa and increases its presence in Egypt.

thumbnail.caption: Hotel Indigo in New Cairo is part of the upcoming Red (G) mixed-use development.

content.summary: European equities traded in the US as American depositary receipts were little change Monday morning

content.title: First Regent resort destination in Japan to open in 2028
content.summary: Situated in Karuizawa town, the luxury resort features an onsen retreat in the luxury mountain destination.

thumbnail.caption: A rendering of the upcoming Regent Karuizawa in Japan. Credit: InterContinental Hotels Group.

content.title: IHG and Four Vedas partner to bring Holiday Inn brand to Siliguri, India
content.summary: Set to open in 2027, the hotel will cater to diverse guest needs in India’s Eastern Province.

thumbnail.caption: IHG Hotels & Resorts operates 51 hotels in India across six brands. Credit: T. Schneider / Shutterstock.com.

content.title: IHG announces Crowne Plaza hotel near Disneyland Paris
content.summary: Set to open in 2026, the development will offer 250 rooms and premium amenities.

thumbnail.caption: Rendering of a guest bathroom at Crowne Plaza Paris - Marne-la-Vallée.

content.title: IHG takes Kimpton brand to Napa Valley
content.summary: The 123-key property, part of IHG Hotels & Resorts’ growing luxury and lifestyle portfolio, is slated to open in the California region in 2028.

thumbnail.caption: A rendering of the forthcoming Kimpton Napa.

content.title: Hotel Indigo opens new 136-room property in Gatlinburg, Tennessee
content.summary: The hotel offers a range of amenities that include event space, fitness centre, dining options and infinity pool.

thumbnail.caption: A guest room of the new Hotel Indigo Gatlinburg Downtown. Credit: Hotel Indigo / PRNewswire.
